Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one free-planar character binding and three text parameters, including an explicit other-instance UUID filter, retains every consumer binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.
